initialFailure.failure: Compose API/web did not become ready.
initialFailure.observed: Internal-network J containers had no published host port; host readiness failed after physical cluster boot. Corrected readiness probes API/web/proxy inside the fixture, with explicit empty J port lists.

secondFailure.observed: Actual API checks passed; immutable-ledger comparison exposed host-local parsing of SQL timestamp without timezone (5:30 shift). Explicit UTC conversion preserves every field/date assertion; regression checks UTC, Asia/Kolkata and America/Los_Angeles.

thirdFailure.observed: J HTTP/objects/fresh Redis/credits/all-worker restart checks passed, then native replay telemetry was NULL after clean physical-export restart. Original pg_last_wal_replay_lsn assertion retained before optional export; post-hook pg_current_wal_lsn additionally required. No recovery assertion removed.
